cnn1d.architecture: Conv1d 1->32 k5, maxpool2, Conv1d 32->64 k3, adaptive average pool

resnet1d.architecture: stem 1->32 k5; two 32-channel residual blocks, dilations 1 and 2

gru.architecture: one-layer GRU, scalar feature input, hidden=48

lstm.architecture: one-layer LSTM, scalar feature input, hidden=48

bilstm.architecture: one-layer bidirectional LSTM, scalar feature input, hidden=48 per direction

cnn_gru.architecture: Conv1d 1->32 k5 and 32->32 k3; one-layer GRU hidden=48

cnn_lstm.architecture: Conv1d 1->32 k5 and 32->32 k3; one-layer LSTM hidden=48

tcn.architecture: 32 channels; three residual two-convolution blocks with dilations 1,2,4; global mean pool

tiny_transformer.architecture: input projection to 32; learned position embedding; 2 encoder layers, 4 heads, FFN=64

feature_sequence_note: Ordered tabular feature vectors are sequence-like inputs for CNN/RNN/TCN/Transformer architectural comparison; they are not temporal sequences.

metrics.roc_auc: macro one-vs-rest ROC AUC over softmax probabilities
metrics.pr_auc: macro arithmetic mean of per-class one-vs-rest trapezoidal precision-recall AUC
